value.rationale: Two sites are the smallest nontrivial inducing-subset selection problem. Complete necessary-and-sufficient submodularity classification pinpoints when standard diminishing-returns-based greedy reasoning is valid. The opposed-response weak-correlation obstruction persists arbitrarily near independent kernels and separates monotonic VFE improvement from submodularity. Exact mathematical motivation is GP inducing subset selection, not arbitrary slice or routine reparameterization.
